meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: Standard presentation of BoP as per BPM6 (DBIE report 58)
meta.coverage: Balance of payments, IMF BPM6 standard presentation, every line, credit, debit and net
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 58, US$ million, from 2011-12. A different presentation from RBI's overall-BoP layout (report 56): primary and secondary income replace 'income' and 'transfers', the financial account is signed as net acquisition of assets minus net incurrence of liabilities. Never joined to or subtracted from the other layout.
